witness.branch: Start from a parked position on a highway
witness.quote: shall not start a vehicle which is stopped, standing or parked on a highway
witness.reason: A departure from a parked position beside a curb can activate the highway-start branch.
required_context: Construct a departure route and nearby-user trajectories.
Document initial parking without actual loading, unloading or passenger exchange.
Establish that parking is permitted at that location and time, retaining the applicable restriction evidence.
Place the entire initial parked footprint within established highway boundaries beside the curb.
Place the entire initial vehicle footprint within documented highway boundaries and establish dedication and public vehicular use.
Specify departure geometry and nearby-user motion; retain safety as an unresolved judgment rather than a gap or braking threshold.
Supply applicable parking restrictions and their location and time scope to establish whether the express exception applies.
Supply public-authority dedication and public vehicular-use facts.
Use an ordinary motor vehicle under a person's physical control, initially parked without actual loading, unloading or passenger exchange.
